title: PUMP vs CUTS PUMP
directVerdict: PUMP is the better fit for pump, while CUTS PUMP is the better fit for pump.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only PUMP discloses: L-Citrulline: 8 g per 2 scoops; Betaine Anhydrous: 2.5 g per 2 scoops; Taurine: 2 g per 2 scoops; Betaine Nitrate: 2 g per 2 scoops; Arginine Nitrate: 1 g per 2 scoops; BioPerine: 5 mg per 2 scoops.
Only CUTS PUMP discloses: Glycerol: 20 g per full serving; L-Carnitine: 1500 mg per full serving; L-Arginine AKG: 1000 mg per full serving.
PUMP caffeine: PUMP is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine. CUTS PUMP caffeine: CUTS PUMP is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: PUMP: PUMP: The strongest pump-specific, stimulant-free powder in the current line, built around citrulline and nitrates. The easiest concrete points are 8 g L-Citrulline, Nitrate-based pump ingredients, Over 16 g actives at two scoops. CUTS PUMP: CUTS PUMP: A caffeine-free liquid glycerol and L-Carnitine product positioned for hydration, pump, and stackability. The easiest concrete points are Liquid format, 20 g glycerol per full cap, Caffeine free.
tradeoffs: PUMP: Customers asking for stimulant energy
CUTS PUMP: Customers asking for stimulant energy
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: PUMP for pump; CUTS PUMP for pump.
